summary: Completed frontend testing of Contact page character portrait overlays feature. Both character images are successfully displayed as decorative overlays above the contact form, positioned left and right with visual enhancements and animations.
passed_tests: Contact page loads successfully at desktop resolution (1920x1080)
Left character portrait overlay is present and visible
Right character portrait overlay is present and visible
Both portraits are correctly positioned (left at x=448, right at x=1242)
Portrait images are enlarged (230px width on desktop, 180px on tablet)
Visual enhancements applied: scale-[1.08], contrast-[1.06], saturate-[1.12], brightness-[1.02]
Animation classes present: float animations (7s/8s), shimmer effects, pulse-glow
Visual effects working: rounded corners, borders, backdrop blur, shadows, gradient overlays
Contact form remains fully functional with portraits present
Form fields (name, email, message) are fillable
Success toast message displays after submission
Responsive behavior: portraits hidden on mobile (390px width)
Responsive behavior: portraits visible on tablet (768px width at md breakpoint)
Responsive behavior: portraits scale correctly (180px on md, 210px on lg, 230px on xl)
Contact form remains accessible and functional on all screen sizes
No console errors or visual errors on the page
